title: An unsolved problem on the powers of 3/2
notes: docs/problems/juggler_three_halves_mod_one.md, docs/problems/juggler_odd_tower_fragment.md. Journal of the Australian Mathematical Society 8 (1968) 313-321. Asks whether some xi > 0 has {xi (3/2)^n} < 1/2 for all n (Z-numbers). Distinct from uniform distribution of {(3/2)^n} itself. The odd-tower fragment cites only the flavor; no transfer is claimed.
